name: Impetus of Hephaestus
description:
You can hand-forge artisan weapons using up to 2 materials and 1 gem. They're unenchantable and low durability, but deal high damage, apply bonus effects per-component, and 🔨**strike the iron**_ _every 10th hit, amplifying effects in +2 radius:

  • Gem: Stacks the gem's stat upon 🔨**striking the iron**.

  • Wood: Attacks 20% faster or 🔨50% faster for 5 seconds.

  • Stone: Attacks stun briefly or 🔨for 2 seconds.

  • Gold: Kills drop +3x of 🔨**+5x **loot.

  • Iron: Chains 2❤️ volcanic lightning or 🔨an 8❤️ eruption.

  • Diamond: 🔨**Striking the iron **stacks forged gems stats twice.

  • Netherite: 3x durability. Can forge with 3 materials/gems.

  • **Hand-forge: **Right-click a weapon material onto a stick in your inventory to forge a sword, or shift-right-click to forge an axe. Further materials and gems can be right-clicked onto an artisan weapon to forge them in. Forged gems are dropped when the weapon breaks.
